realtime_memories.content: Turborepo monorepo with 9 subdomain apps (www, thoughts, dev, links, updates, metrics, status, lab, docs) and shared packages (ui, lib, types, config, styles). Three-layer shared system: @anipotts/lib (plain helpers) → @anipotts/ui (client components with callback props) → per-app actions.ts (thin 'use server' wrappers). Shared packages built with tsup. GitHub: https://github.com/anipotts/anipotts.com.

Accent: #61ABEA (blue). Handles: @anipottsbuilds (social), @anipotts (GitHub/LinkedIn). Email: contact@anipotts.com. Bio: 'minimal interfaces to orchestrate complex systems'. Terminal header: 'ani@potts:~/[domain]' with responsive prefix hiding. Font: JetBrains Mono. Design tokens in packages/styles/src/tokens.css (light in :root, dark in .dark).

Shared data in @anipotts/lib with tsup multi-entry builds. Modules: data/ (projects, social, site, services, SITE_VERSION), admin/ (auth, thoughts CRUD), metrics/ (GitHub/WakaTime, Supabase cache), status/ (HTTP checker), typefully/ (API wrapper). Supabase tables: thoughts, atoms, metrics_cache, status_checks, favorite_numbers. Vercel Crons: metrics daily 6AM UTC, status every 5 min. Import Supabase via @anipotts/lib/supabase, Typefully via @anipotts/lib/typefully. Env vars: NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY (www only), NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, ADMIN_PASSWORD, GITHUB_TOKEN, WAKATIME_API_KEY, CRON_SECRET, TYPEFULLY_API_KEY (server-side only). Use printf (not echo) for env vars. Dev: 'pnpm turbo dev --concurrency=15'.

Admin accessed via Cmd+Shift+A (hidden), cookie-based auth per domain. TerminalNavigator (Ctrl+`) on all 9 apps via @anipotts/ui/terminal-navigator. ./server export uses source path (not dist) to avoid tsup dual-config issues. Shared next config in packages/config/next/base.ts. DO NOT use serverExternalPackages for framer-motion (breaks SSG). Use turbopack.resolveAlias for node:fs stub. PostHog only configured on www Vercel project. STRICT WRITING RULES (NON-NEGOTIABLE): Never use em dashes. Never list exactly 3 items (use 2, 4+, or inline prose).

Typefully CLI at .agents/skills/typefully/scripts/typefully.js (deleted; now use @anipotts/lib/typefully for programmatic access). Config in .typefully/config.json (project-local, gitignored). Default social set: 280784 (@anipottsbuilds). Connected platforms: X, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon. Creator plan trial until Mar 1 2026: 15 posts/month, unlimited drafts. LinkedIn does NOT support threads via API. Admin ScheduleTab now has live Typefully integration (status bar, queue, schedule/publish actions, atom push). TypefullyStatusWidget in AdminHub command bar. Content pipeline: Supabase thoughts+atoms tables, content-config/ voice guides, scripts/ CLI tools.

Jan 29: Ecosystem unification (shared data layer, admin, metrics, status). Jan 30: Light/dark/system theme, deep cleanup, dependency alignment, shared next config. Jan 31: Terminal Navigator on all 9 apps, subdomain polish. Feb 1: Typefully skill setup, 6 quant interview threads drafted for X/Threads/Bluesky. Feb 2: Full Typefully API integration in admin (types, lib, server actions, ScheduleTab rewrite, status widget). Mastodon platform added. Codebase cleanup (moved ADMIN_CONTENT_HUB_DESIGN.md to .claude/docs/, removed .agents/ duplicate, deleted stale typefully-cli.ts). Writing rules enforced (no em dashes, no triplets). All 6 drafts updated on Typefully. All apps build clean.
Memory consolidated: 10 entries down to 6. Removed 4 noise entries (truncated claude responses, raw message captures). Merged content_system with Typefully integration updates, updated completed_work
